mapper.select: select room_id roomId,room_name roomName from live_room where status='0' order by room_name

select u.user_id userId,u.nick_name userName,b.ding_user_id dingUserId from live_subject_user_map m join sys_user u on u.user_id=m.user_id and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' left join live_ding_user_bind b on b.user_id=u.user_id where m.subject_type='ROOM' and m.subject_id=#{roomId} and m.role_code='anchor' order by u.nick_name

select u.user_id userId,u.nick_name userName,b.ding_user_id dingUserId from sys_user u left join live_ding_user_bind b on b.user_id=u.user_id where u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' order by u.nick_name
select r.room_id roomId,r.room_name roomName from live_metric_room_alias a join live_room r on r.room_id=a.room_id and r.status='0' where a.alias_key=#{aliasKey} limit 1
select count(*) from sys_user where user_id=#{userId} and status='0' and del_flag='0'
select count(*) from live_subject_user_map where subject_type='ROOM' and subject_id=#{roomId} and user_id=#{userId} and role_code='anchor'
mapper.delete: delete from live_subject_user_map where subject_type='ROOM' and subject_id=#{roomId} and user_id=#{userId} and role_code='anchor'
mapper.sql: session_id sessionId,room_id roomId,platform_session_id platformSessionId,reported_room_name reportedRoomName,live_start_time liveStartTime,status,version,last_snapshot_at lastSnapshotAt
mapper.select: select from live_metric_session where platform_session_id=#{platformSessionId}
select from live_metric_session where session_id=#{sessionId}
select from live_metric_session where session_id=#{sessionId} for update
mapper.sql: snapshot_id snapshotId,session_id sessionId,snapshot_kind snapshotKind,captured_at capturedAt,watch_total watchTotal,interaction_total interactionTotal,new_fan_total newFanTotal,deal_total dealTotal,gmv_total gmvTotal,ad_cost_total adCostTotal,presale_order_total presaleOrderTotal,exposure_watch_rate exposureWatchRate,watch_follow_rate watchFollowRate,watch_interaction_rate watchInteractionRate,watch_deal_rate watchDealRate
mapper.select: select from live_metric_snapshot where idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}

select from live_metric_snapshot where snapshot_id=coalesce( (select end_snapshot_id from live_metric_anchor_segment where session_id=#{sessionId} and status='CLOSED' and end_snapshot_id is not null order by end_time desc,segment_id desc limit 1), (select snapshot_id from live_metric_snapshot where session_id=#{sessionId} and snapshot_kind='ZERO' order by captured_at,snapshot_id limit 1) )
select from live_metric_snapshot where snapshot_id=#{snapshotId}

select s.segment_id segmentId,s.session_id sessionId,s.room_id roomId,s.anchor_user_id anchorUserId,u.nick_name anchorName,s.start_snapshot_id startSnapshotId,s.end_snapshot_id endSnapshotId,s.start_time startTime,s.end_time endTime,s.status,s.precision_status precisionStatus,s.version,s.source,s.operator_user_id operatorUserId,s.client_version clientVersion,s.create_by operatorName,s.remark,s.watch_delta watchDelta,s.interaction_delta interactionDelta,s.new_fan_delta newFanDelta,s.deal_delta dealDelta,s.gmv_delta gmvDelta,s.ad_cost_delta adCostDelta,s.presale_order_delta presaleOrderDelta,s.exposure_watch_rate exposureWatchRate,s.watch_follow_rate watchFollowRate,s.watch_interaction_rate watchInteractionRate,s.watch_deal_rate watchDealRate,s.void_reason voidReason,s.void_name voidName,s.void_at voidAt from live_metric_anchor_segment s join sys_user u on u.user_id=s.anchor_user_id where s.segment_id=#{segmentId}
select count(*) from live_metric_anchor_segment where session_id=#{sessionId} and status='CLOSED' and start_time<#{endTime} and end_time>#{startTime} and segment_id<>#{excludeSegmentId}
mapper.update: update live_metric_anchor_segment set anchor_user_id=#{anchorUserId},start_snapshot_id=#{startSnapshotId},end_snapshot_id=#{endSnapshotId},start_time=#{startTime},end_time=#{endTime},precision_status=#{precisionStatus},source=#{source},remark=#{remark},watch_delta=#{watchDelta},interaction_delta=#{interactionDelta},new_fan_delta=#{newFanDelta},deal_delta=#{dealDelta},gmv_delta=#{gmvDelta},ad_cost_delta=#{adCostDelta},presale_order_delta=#{presaleOrderDelta},exposure_watch_rate=#{exposureWatchRate},watch_follow_rate=#{watchFollowRate},watch_interaction_rate=#{watchInteractionRate},watch_deal_rate=#{watchDealRate},version=version+1,update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=now() where segment_id=#{segmentId} and version=#{version}

update live_metric_anchor_segment set status='VOID',void_reason=#{reason},void_by=#{userId},void_name=#{userName},void_at=now(),version=version+1,update_by=#{userName},update_time=now() where segment_id=#{segmentId} and version=#{version} and status='CLOSED'
mapper.select: select r.room_id roomId,r.room_name roomName,group_concat(distinct u.nick_name order by u.nick_name separator '、') anchorNames, (select s.platform_session_id from live_metric_session s where s.room_id=r.room_id order by s.live_start_time desc limit 1) platformSessionId, (select s.live_start_time from live_metric_session s where s.room_id=r.room_id order by s.live_start_time desc limit 1) liveStartTime, (select max(s.last_snapshot_at) from live_metric_session s where s.room_id=r.room_id) lastSnapshotAt, (select u2.nick_name from live_metric_anchor_segment g2 join sys_user u2 on u2.user_id=g2.anchor_user_id where g2.room_id=r.room_id and g2.status='CLOSED' order by g2.end_time desc,g2.segment_id desc limit 1) lastAnchorName, (select count(*) from live_metric_anchor_segment g3 where g3.status='CLOSED' and g3.session_id=(select s3.session_id from live_metric_session s3 where s3.room_id=r.room_id order by s3.live_start_time desc limit 1)) latestSegmentCount, (select count(*) from live_metric_anchor_segment g where g.room_id=r.room_id and g.status='CLOSED' and g.precision_status<>'EXACT') exceptionCount from live_room r left join live_subject_user_map m on m.subject_type='ROOM' and m.subject_id=r.room_id and m.role_code='anchor' left join sys_user u on u.user_id=m.user_id and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' where r.status='0' group by r.room_id,r.room_name order by r.room_name
select room_id roomId,room_name roomName,live_account liveAccount from live_room where room_id=#{roomId} and status='0'

select s.session_id sessionId,s.room_id roomId,s.platform_session_id platformSessionId,s.reported_room_name reportedRoomName,s.live_start_time liveStartTime,s.status,s.last_snapshot_at lastSnapshotAt,count(g.segment_id) segmentCount,coalesce(sum(g.precision_status<>'EXACT'),0) exceptionCount from live_metric_session s left join live_metric_anchor_segment g on g.session_id=s.session_id and g.status='CLOSED' where s.room_id=#{roomId} and s.live_start_time>=concat(#{beginDate},' 00:00:00') and s.live_start_time<date_add(#{endDate},interval 1 day) group by s.session_id order by s.live_start_time desc limit 100

select g.segment_id segmentId,g.session_id sessionId,g.anchor_user_id anchorUserId,u.nick_name anchorName,g.start_snapshot_id startSnapshotId,g.end_snapshot_id endSnapshotId,g.start_time startTime,g.end_time endTime,g.status,g.precision_status precisionStatus,g.version,g.source,g.operator_user_id operatorUserId,g.client_version clientVersion,g.create_by operatorName,g.remark,g.watch_delta watchDelta,g.interaction_delta interactionDelta,g.new_fan_delta newFanDelta,g.deal_delta dealDelta,g.gmv_delta gmvDelta,g.ad_cost_delta adCostDelta,g.presale_order_delta presaleOrderDelta,g.exposure_watch_rate exposureWatchRate,g.watch_follow_rate watchFollowRate,g.watch_interaction_rate watchInteractionRate,g.watch_deal_rate watchDealRate from live_metric_anchor_segment g join sys_user u on u.user_id=g.anchor_user_id where g.session_id=#{sessionId} and g.status='CLOSED' order by g.start_time,g.segment_id
select from live_metric_snapshot where session_id=#{sessionId} order by captured_at,snapshot_id

select correction_id correctionId,segment_id segmentId,action_type actionType,old_value oldValue,new_value newValue,reason,corrected_name correctedName,corrected_at correctedAt from live_metric_segment_correction where session_id=#{sessionId} order by corrected_at desc limit 200
